text: DSH Skill Mini Manager 是面向 DSH Web 的 skill 管理设置页，与插件导航同级。它读取 DSH skill 注册表，列出 skill 名称、简介、使用时机、来源和占用，并支持搜索与刷新。对可移除的用户 skill，页面先显示确认，再将目录移入回收站，支持恢复或清空回收站。适合希望在 Web 设置中查看和整理已安装 skill 的用户；需要 DSH Web 及其 skills、webServer 服务，不需要额外密钥或外部账号。

DSH Skill Mini Manager adds a DSH Web Settings page to list and search installed skills, showing their source and size. Users can move removable skills to a recoverable trash, restore them, or empty it. It requires DSH Web skills and webServer services, with no extra key or account.
想在 DSH Web 设置里查看所有已安装的 skill。
如何把不再需要的 skill 暂时移走，还能之后恢复？
I want to search my installed DSH skills and restore one I removed earlier.
Skill Mini Manager 的功能「浏览与筛选 skill」：在 DSH Web 设置页查看名称、简介、来源和占用，并按名称或简介搜索；页面可刷新目录。
Skill Mini Manager 的功能「回收站管理」：确认后将可移除的 skill 目录移入回收站，之后可恢复，或确认清空回收站。

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · dsh-skill-mini-manager · skill 极简管理：[English](README.en.md) | 中文

DSH Web 设置里的一页 **skill 管理器**：把当前 DSH 装的全部 skill 列出来，展示每个
skill 自己的简介，并且可以逐个移除。

- **插件 id**：`dsh-skill-mini-manager`
- **中文名**：skill 极简管理
- **英文名**：Skill Mini Manager

它的位置与内置的「**插件**」分区**同级**——设置面板左侧同一层导航里的独立一页，
不是「插件」里的一个标签页。

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · 它显示什么：每一行是一个 skill，显示：

| 字段 | 来源 |
|---|---|
| **名称** | skill frontmatter 的 `name` |
| **简介** | skill frontmatter 的 `description`（skill 自己写的那段路由说明，原样展示） |
| **使用时机** | 可选的 `whenToUse` |
| **来源** | `user-dsh` / `user-agents` / `project-dsh` / `project-agents` / `custom` / `bundled` |
| **可调用面** | 模型可调用 / 用户可调用（对应 `disable-model-invocation`、`user-invocable`） |
| **占用** | skill 目录的绝对路径、文件数、总字节数 |
| **提供给** | 哪些预设（或全局层）会把这个 skill 交给 agent |

页面顶部有搜索框（按名称 / 简介 / 使用时机过滤）、刷新按钮和计数，底部是回收站。

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · skill 存在哪一层（重要）：DSH 的 skill 注册表是 **host + 按 scope 分层**的：部署级 provider 注册进**全局层**，
而每个 agent 预设自己的 `skill-filesystem` 行注册进**那个预设的层**。关键在于
`dsh-web-app` 的补丁**显式禁用了宿主机上的 `skill-filesystem` 行**（原注释写明
「presets own local discovery」），所以**全局层在标准 web profile 上是空的**，
所有用户 skill 都活在预设层里——只读全局层会得到一份空目录。

因此本插件**逐个读取**：全局层 + roster 里每个预设的层，然后按名称合并。预设的读取走 DSH
为「没有 agent 的宿主读取者」提供的读取 scope，**两代 API 都兼容**：

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · skill 存在哪一层（重要）：- **DSH 0.2 起**：`acquireScope(id)`，返回一个**租约**（`{ key } & AsyncDisposable`），
  读完该 scope 后必须 `dispose`，否则那份预设修订会被一直留在内存里。本插件在
  `finally` 里释放，读取抛错也照样释放。
- **DSH 0.1.x**：`standingKeyFor(id)`，直接返回 key，没有东西需要释放。

读不通的预设会**明确报在页面上**，而不是静默少列几个 skill。

于是每个 skill 会标出它被**哪些预设提供**（例如 `提供给 预设 standard · 预设 code`）；
预设自带 `skills/` 目录里的私有 skill（例如内置 `cordis` 预设的两个）只标它自己。
同名 skill 在不同预设里指向**不同文件**时，页面会列出它但标为不可移除（`ambiguous`）。

内容完全来自宿主真实运行的 `ctx.skills` 注册表：每次打开或刷新都现场读取，没有缓存，
所以页面上看到的就是模型此刻能加载的东西。

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · 移除是怎么做的：点「移除」会进入二次确认，确认框里会显示**将要移动的确切路径**。确认后：

1. 宿主机把整个 skill 目录（或扁平 skill 的那一个 `.md` 文件）**移动**到
   `<DSH_HOME>/.skill-mini-manager/trash/<时间戳>-<名称>-<随机串>/payload`，并在同目录写入
   `meta.json` 记录原始路径。
2. 该位置在所有 skill 根目录之外，所以文件系统 provider 的一层发现再也看不到它——
   skill 立刻从模型目录里消失（provider 自带的 watcher 会触发失效）。
3. 页面底部的**回收站**列出已移除的 skill，每项都有**恢复**按钮，会把它移回原路径。
   **清空回收站**是插件里唯一不可逆的操作，同样需要二次确认。

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · 什么不能被移除：移除在宿主侧做了一组硬性拒绝，页面会显示拒绝原因而不是给出按钮：

| 原因 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| `bundled-source` | DSH 内置打包的 skill（`DSH_BUNDLED_SKILL_DIR`），属于发行物而不是用户资产 |
| `runtime-provider` | 由插件在运行时注册的 skill，根本没有文件 |
| `system-owned` | 位于系统保留的 `.system` 目录内 |
| `not-on-disk` | 定义里没有文件路径 |
| `outside-skill-roots` | 不在任何已知 skill 根目录内 |
| `unsupported-layout` | 既不是 `<name>/SKILL.md`，也不是 `<name>.md` |
| `missing` | 目录还在但 `SKILL.md` 已经不见了 |
| `ambiguous` | 同名 skill 在不同预设层里指向不同文件；页面只发名称，没有唯一目标就不猜 |

再加两条结构性保证：

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · 什么不能被移除：- **浏览器永远不传路径。** 页面只发 skill 名称（`remove`）或回收站条目 id（`restore`/`purge`），
  宿主每次都用自己的规则重新解析目标路径。被篡改的页面无法让这个插件去删任意文件。
- **删除目标永远不会是 skill 根目录本身。** 一个直接躺在根目录里的 `SKILL.md` 会被拒绝，
  而不是把整个 `skills/` 目录移走。

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · 宿主接口：宿主半侧在 `webServer` 上挂四条 exact 路由，全部只接受同源请求（`Origin` 与 `Host`
不一致即 403）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/dsh-skill-mini-manager/api/catalog` | skill 列表 + 回收站 + 根目录状态 |
| `POST` | `/dsh-skill-mini-manager/api/remove` | `{"name":"<skill>"}` |
| `POST` | `/dsh-skill-mini-manager/api/restore` | `{"id":"<回收站条目>"}` |
| `POST` | `/dsh-skill-mini-manager/api/purge` | 清空回收站 |

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · 安装：本插件是一个标准的 DSH bundle（声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch` 与 `dsh.client`）。
三条路任选一条，装完都要**重启一次** `dsh web`。

**先说清楚一件事**：本插件**没有构建步骤**——浏览器半侧 `lib/client.js` 是手写的
`__ModuleLoader__` bundle，而且**已经提交进仓库**，`package.json` 里也没有 `prepare` 脚本。
所以三条路都不需要「先构建」，GitHub 直装通常也不会触发构建审批。

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · 安装：| 路 | 命令 | 适合谁 | 需要什么 | 更新方式 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ① npm | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skill-mini-manager` | 绝大多数人：只是想用它 | 无（包内已带全部产物） | `dsh plugin --profile web up dsh-skill-mini-manager` |
| ② GitHub 直装 | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:runcat-tommy/dsh-skill-mini-manager` | 想跟仓库最新提交，而不是发布版 | 本机有 `git`；若 DSH 要求构建审批就同意 | 重跑同一条命令 |
| ③ 下载到本地 | `dsh plugin --profile web add <本地目录>` | 要读/改代码、要离线、或本机**没有 git** | 无（`git clone` 或 **Download ZIP** 都行） | 重新 `git pull` / 重新下载 |
dsh-skill-mini-manager README · 安装：一句话：**能装 npm 就装 npm**（一条命令、不依赖 `git`）；要跟最新提交走 ②；要动代码或没有 `git` 走 ③。

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · ① 从 npm 装（推荐）：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skill-mini-manager
```

包内已带全部产物，不执行任何安装脚本，也不需要 `git`——前置条件最少的一条路。
发布历史见 <https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-skill-mini-manager>。

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · 装箱内容：| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半侧：四条 HTTP 路由、回收站、全部拒绝规则 |
| `lib/catalog.js` | 纯函数核心：根目录解析、`planRemoval`、回收站命名校验 |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半侧：手写的 `__ModuleLoader__` bundle，注册 `settings.section` |
| `test/` | 70 个测试：纯规则、宿主半侧（真实临时目录 + 分层读取）、浏览器半侧结构、发布产物门槛 |
| `scripts/inspect-live-catalog.mjs` | 只读探针：用本机已装的 skill 跑一遍目录读取与移除规划 |

浏览器半侧不需要构建步骤：它只 `require("react")` 这一颗平台种子，其余全部用
同源 `fetch` 与宿主半侧对话。文案通过 `locale` 服务注册中英双语，跟随 DSH 界面语言。

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · 开发：```bash
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"          # 全部 70 个测试
node scripts/inspect-live-catalog.mjs  # 用本机真实 skill 做只读验证
```

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · 模型体验：**无。** 本插件不注册提示词、工具、消息或提供方请求。它唯一对模型的可见影响是间接的：
移除一个 skill 之后，文件系统 provider 会让该 skill 从模型目录中消失——这正是「移除」
的本意，而目录本身由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill` 渲染。

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · KV Cache 影响：移除会触发 provider 失效，从而使目录消费方在既有请求历史后追加一份替换目录。
浏览这一页不会增加任何模型 token。

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · 已知限制与暂缓事项：- **只列用户级 skill。** 设置面板没有工作区，所以目录读取不带 `cwd`：项目根下的
  `.dsh/skills` 与 `.agents/skills` 不会出现。要管理项目 skill，需要一个带工作区上下文的入口。
- **判据是路径形状，而不是 provider 自述。** 自定义根目录只要目录名不是 `skills`，
  就会被 `outside-skill-roots` 拒绝——这是有意的保守选择，代价是这类部署需要显式声明根目录。
- **移除是「移走」而不是「卸载」。** 插件不碰 `package.json`、registry 或插件装配；
  它只搬动 skill 自己的目录。
- **回收站不会被自动清理。** 需要用户显式清空。
- **每条路由都现场重算目录。** skill 数量很大时每次刷新都会重读一遍全部定义；
  「极简」在这里意味着不做缓存，而不是省这一次读取。

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · dsh-skill-mini-manager · Skill Mini Manager：English | [中文](README.md)

One **skill manager** page inside DSH Web Settings: it lists every skill the
installation currently serves, shows each skill's own summary, and removes any
of them.

- **Plugin id**: `dsh-skill-mini-manager`
- **English name**: Skill Mini Manager
- **Chinese name**: skill 极简管理

It sits at the **same level as the built-in 插件 (Plugins) section** — its own
entry in the same tier of the Settings sidebar, not a tab inside Plugins.

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · What it shows：| Field | Source |
|---|---|
| **Name** | the skill frontmatter's `name` |
| **Summary** | the skill frontmatter's `description` — the routing text the skill itself wrote, shown verbatim |
| **When to use** | the optional `whenToUse` |
| **Source** | `user-dsh` / `user-agents` / `project-dsh` / `project-agents` / `custom` / `bundled` |
| **Invocable on** | model / user (`disable-model-invocation`, `user-invocable`) |
| **Footprint** | the skill directory's absolute path, file count and byte total |
| **Served to** | which presets (or the global layer) hand this skill to an agent |

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · What it shows：The top of the page carries a filter (name, summary or when-to-use), a refresh
action and a count; the trash sits at the bottom.

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · Which layer a skill lives in (important)：The DSH skill registry is **host + per-scope layered**: deployment-level
providers register into the **global layer**, while each agent preset's own
`skill-filesystem` row registers into **that preset's layer**. The catch is that
`dsh-web-app`'s patch **disables the host `skill-filesystem` row** ("presets own
local discovery"), so on a stock web profile **the global layer is empty** and
every user skill lives in a preset layer — reading the global layer alone yields
an empty catalog.
section: Which layer a skill lives in (important)

text:
dsh-skill-mini-manager README · Which layer a skill lives in (important)：So this plugin reads **every view**: the global layer plus each preset in the
roster, merged by name. A preset is read through the scope DSH provides for a
host reader with no agent, and **both API generations are supported**:
section: Which layer a skill lives in (important)

text:
dsh-skill-mini-manager README · Which layer a skill lives in (important)：- **DSH 0.2 and later**: `acquireScope(id)`, which returns a *lease*
  (`{ key } & AsyncDisposable`). It must be disposed once the scoped read is
  done, or that preset revision is retained in memory; this plugin releases it in
  a `finally`, including when the read throws.
- **DSH 0.1.x**: `standingKeyFor(id)`, which returns the key directly and has
  nothing to release.

A preset that cannot be read is **reported on the page** rather than silently
costing you rows.
section: Which layer a skill lives in (important)

text:
dsh-skill-mini-manager README · Which layer a skill lives in (important)：Each skill therefore names the presets that **serve it** (e.g.
`served to preset standard · preset code`), and a skill from a preset-private
`skills/` directory (such as the two the shipped `cordis` preset carries) names
only that preset. A name that resolves to **different files** in different
presets is listed but never offered for removal (`ambiguous`).
section: Which layer a skill lives in (important)

text:
dsh-skill-mini-manager README · Which layer a skill lives in (important)：Everything comes from the host's live `ctx.skills` registry: every open or
refresh re-reads it with no caching, so the page shows what the model can load
right now.
section: Which layer a skill lives in (important)

text:
dsh-skill-mini-manager README · How removal works：**Remove** opens a two-step confirm that names the exact path that will move.
On confirmation the host:

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · How removal works：1. **Moves** the whole skill directory (or the single `.md` file of a flat skill)
   to `<DSH_HOME>/.skill-mini-manager/trash/<stamp>-<name>-<nonce>/payload`,
   writing a `meta.json` beside it that records the original path.
2. That location is outside every scanned skill root, so the filesystem
   provider's one-level discovery can never see it again — the skill leaves the
   model catalog immediately (the provider's own watcher invalidates).
3. The **trash** at the bottom of the page lists removed skills, each with a
   **Restore** action that moves it back to its original path. **Empty trash**
   is the only irreversible verb in the plugin, and it confirms first too.
dsh-skill-mini-manager README · What cannot be removed：Refusals are enforced on the host; the page shows the reason instead of a button.

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · What cannot be removed：| Reason | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `bundled-source` | a DSH-bundled skill (`DSH_BUNDLED_SKILL_DIR`) — a distribution artifact, not user content |
| `runtime-provider` | registered by a plugin at runtime; it has no files |
| `system-owned` | inside the system-owned `.system` directory |
| `not-on-disk` | the definition carries no file path |
| `outside-skill-roots` | outside every known skill root |
| `unsupported-layout` | neither `<name>/SKILL.md` nor `<name>.md` |
| `missing` | the directory is there but `SKILL.md` is gone |
| `ambiguous` | the name resolves to different files in different preset layers; the page sends only a name, so there is no single target and it refuses to guess |

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · What cannot be removed：Plus two structural guarantees:

- **The browser never sends a path.** The page sends a skill name (`remove`) or
  a trash entry id (`restore`/`purge`); the host re-derives the target from its
  own rules every time. A compromised page cannot make this plugin delete an
  arbitrary file.
- **The removal target is never a skill root itself.** A bare `SKILL.md` sitting
  directly in a root is refused rather than taking the whole `skills/` directory
  with it.

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · Host interface：The host half mounts four exact routes on `webServer`. All of them accept
same-origin requests only (an `Origin` that disagrees with `Host` is a 403):

| Method | Path | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/dsh-skill-mini-manager/api/catalog` | skills + trash + root status |
| `POST` | `/dsh-skill-mini-manager/api/remove` | `{"name":"<skill>"}` |
| `POST` | `/dsh-skill-mini-manager/api/restore` | `{"id":"<trash entry>"}` |
| `POST` | `/dsh-skill-mini-manager/api/purge` | empty the trash |

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · Installing：This is a standard DSH bundle (it declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and `dsh.client`).
Pick any one of three routes; **all three need one `dsh web` restart** afterwards.

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · Installing：**One thing to know up front**: this plugin has **no build step** — the browser half
`lib/client.js` is a hand-written `__ModuleLoader__` bundle that is **committed to
the repository**, and `package.json` declares no `prepare` script. So no route needs
a build first, and a GitHub-source install does not normally trigger a build approval.

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · Installing：| Route | Command | Best for | Needs | Updating |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ① npm | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skill-mini-manager` | almost everyone: you just want to use it | nothing (the tarball carries every artifact) | `dsh plugin --profile web up dsh-skill-mini-manager` |
| ② GitHub source | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:runcat-tommy/dsh-skill-mini-manager` | tracking the newest commit rather than a release | `git` on the machine; approve the build if DSH asks | re-run the same command |
| ③ Local download | `dsh plugin --profile web add <local dir>` | reading/editing the code, working offline, or **no git installed** | nothing (`git clone` or **Download ZIP**) | `git pull` / download again |

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · Installing：In one line: **prefer npm** (one command, no `git`); use ② to track the newest commit;
use ③ to change the code or when `git` is not available.

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · ① From npm (recommended)：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skill-mini-manager
```

The tarball carries every artifact, runs no install script, and needs no `git` — the
fewest preconditions of the three. Release history:

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · The restart is not optional：The host half mounts its routes at startup. A mere page refresh makes the page say
so explicitly ("the plugin's host half did not answer") rather than rendering blank.

Inspect and uninstall:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web list
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-skill-mini-manager
```

(Removing a *skill* is a different thing — this plugin never touches package
dependencies.)

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · What ships：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | host half: the four routes, the trash, every refusal rule |
| `lib/catalog.js` | the pure core: home/root resolution, `planRemoval`, trash-name validation |
| `lib/client.js` | browser half: a hand-written `__ModuleLoader__` bundle registering the `settings.section` |
| `test/` | 70 tests: pure rules, host half over real temp directories (including the layered read), browser-half structure, release-artifact gates |
| `scripts/inspect-live-catalog.mjs` | read-only probe: run the catalog and removal planning over the skills actually installed here |

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · What ships：The browser half needs no build step: it requires only the `react` platform seed
and talks to its host half over same-origin `fetch`. All copy is registered
bilingually through the `locale` service and follows the DSH UI language.

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · Developing：```bash
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"          # all 70 tests
node scripts/inspect-live-catalog.mjs  # read-only check against the real installed skills
```

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · Model experience：**None.** This plugin registers no prompt, tool, message or provider request.
Its only model-visible effect is indirect: removing a skill makes the filesystem
provider drop it from the model catalog — which is exactly what removal means,
and the catalog itself is rendered by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill`.

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · KV cache impact：A removal trips provider invalidation, so a catalog consumer appends a
replacement catalog after the existing request history. Browsing this page adds
no model tokens.

dsh-skill-mini-manager README · Known limitations and deferrals：- **User-level skills only.** The Settings panel has no workspace, so discovery
  runs without a `cwd`: project-level `.dsh/skills` and `.agents/skills` do not
  appear. Managing project skills needs an entry point that carries a workspace.
- **The verdict is path shape, not the provider's own account.** A custom root
  whose directory is not literally named `skills` is refused as
  `outside-skill-roots` — deliberately conservative, at the cost of such a
  deployment having to declare its roots.
- **Removal means "move away", not "uninstall".** The plugin never touches
  `package.json`, a registry, or plugin composition; it only moves a skill's own
  directory.
- **The trash is never cleaned up automatically.** Emptying it is a user action.
- **Every route recomputes the catalog.** With very many skills each refresh
  re-reads every definition; "minimal" here means no cache, not skipping the
  read.
